description: This file defines a simple REST controller in a Spring Boot application, providing basic endpoints for health check, welcome message, documentation redirection, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints for greeting, documentation access, health check, and application info.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Returns a welcome message for the application.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Redirects to the Swagger UI page for API documentation.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns the application health status as 'OK'.
